candidates.description: This vector represents a multilingual mixture of common short function words, suffixes, and character fragments.
This vector represents Indic and Cyrillic character sequences and subword fragments involving dental consonants and nasal vowels.
This vector represents Hindi character subwords and linguistic components.
This feature vector activates strongly on specific Devanagari vowel-consonant character sequences and common word fragments.
This vector activates strongly on characters, root words, and suffixes specific to the Devanagari script used for Hindi and related languages.
This vector represents labiodental and bilabial consonant characters and sub-word tokens across different scripts.
This feature vector activates on character n-grams and suffixes commonly found in Hindi words and proper names.
This vector is sensitive to common Hindi syllable prefixes and root fragments.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign combinations and diphthongs used in word inflections.
This vector activates on common Hindi words, prefixes, and subword tokens.
